rows.surface: Player fields: run state, parity time, frame accumulator, frame rate, input, mouse, current frame, RNG
rows.capture_rule: Read through an internal checkpoint hook after the clean barrier; retain exact integer/rational clocks and RNG state.
rows.restore_rule: Populate candidate Player before publication; reconstruct wall-clock Instant and process-local weak references.

rows.capture_rule: Traverse ordered display roots, child/depth order, strong and weak edges; register node kind before fields.
rows.restore_rule: Allocate all display nodes by GraphId, populate scalars, then fix parent/child, mask, AVM object, frame and target references.
rows.capability: supported-design; exact live node kinds pending the first experiment
rows.unsupported_reason: Any encountered node kind absent from the versioned registry fails capture.

rows.surface: Avm1 global environments, constant pool, operand stack, registers, execution list
rows.capture_rule: Capture logical heap/scope/object references, persistent operand/register values, and scalar runtime flags when their semantics survive between actions; require no current Activation or executing handler.
rows.restore_rule: Allocate/fix AVM1 graph and immutable SWF slices without running startup or handlers.
rows.unsupported_reason: Current Activation/local registers or executing handler are C2/unsupported; persistent Avm1 stack/register values are captured when semantically live.

rows.surface: Avm2 operand/scope/call stacks, domains, classes, broadcast list and aliases
rows.capture_rule: Capture only logical graph state exposed by the future internal hook; empty call/operand/scope execution stacks are required for C1.
rows.restore_rule: Allocate domains/classes and fix object/prototype/scope/broadcast edges from stable IDs.
rows.unsupported_reason: Nonempty AVM2 call/operand/scope continuation is C2/unsupported here.

rows.surface: AVM1 functions and AVM2 bound methods, scopes, receivers, prototypes and constant pools
rows.capture_rule: Encode immutable code slice identity plus logical captured scope/receiver/prototype edges; reject native/Rust closures without a registered logical form.
rows.restore_rule: Rebind code to matching immutable asset and fix captured graph references before any invocation.
rows.unsupported_reason: Unknown native closure or function kind fails closed.

rows.surface: ActionQueue priority buckets, QueuedAction target clip and ActionType
rows.capture_rule: Preserve priority/FIFO order and target GraphIds; validate ActionType registry and unload semantics.
rows.restore_rule: Populate queues after graph allocation and before publication; do not drain them during capture or restore.
rows.unsupported_reason: Unknown action or unresolved target rejects capture.

rows.surface: Timers binary heap, timer counter, logical time and callback variants
rows.capture_rule: Preserve heap order/deadlines, IDs, current logical time, callback identity and parameters; do not run callbacks.
rows.restore_rule: Rebuild timer heap with fixed function/method/receiver IDs and exact logical clock.
rows.unsupported_reason: Opaque callback or unresolved method/receiver fails closed.

rows.surface: LoadManager and MovieLoader target, request/status and partial movie state
rows.capture_rule: Inspect without executing; allow only frozen deterministic bytes and registered callback state with no external effect.
rows.restore_rule: Rehydrate from captured immutable bytes/metadata or reject; never reconnect or rerun a network request.
rows.unsupported_reason: Active opaque future, network request, or external side effect is unsupported.

rows.surface: PostFrameCallback display object plus Box<dyn FnOnce>
rows.capture_rule: Detect nonempty callback list during the internal eligibility walk without invoking or draining it.
rows.restore_rule: Reject unless a later versioned logical callback registry replaces the Rust closure.
rows.unsupported_reason: Opaque Rust closure cannot be serialized or safely replayed.

rows.surface: Sockets, NetConnections, LocalConnections, ExternalInterface and navigator futures
rows.capture_rule: Detect active connection/future/effect state without advancing it; classify deterministic local messages separately.
rows.restore_rule: Rebuild only logical local state with registered callback IDs; reject network reconnection or external effect replay.
rows.unsupported_reason: Opaque network/external future or side effect is unsupported.

rows.surface: DynamicRootSet, weak display/broadcast references and orphan manager
rows.capture_rule: Enumerate explicit dynamic roots and weak edges; serialize nil/dead only when actually nil/dead or a target GraphId only when already strongly retained; addresses are ephemeral alias-map keys only and weak-only liveness is future work.
rows.restore_rule: Allocate strong graph first, then rebuild dynamic/weak bindings and orphan membership; reject live weak-only targets.
rows.unsupported_reason: Private root enumeration is unavailable through current public Player API; live weak target absent from strong graph is weak_target_not_strongly_retained.

rows.capture_rule: Record backend/build configuration plus persistent pixels, dynamic drawing commands/state, masks, trails, filters, and cache-as-bitmap source inputs; derived GPU/command/cache artifacts are rebuilt.
rows.restore_rule: Allocate fresh process-local backends and upload/rebuild resources before publication.
rows.unsupported_reason: Raw OS/GPU handles and opaque backend internals are not portable checkpoint state.

rows.surface: Ruffle NullAudioBackend and Flash sound manager
rows.observed_actual: observed-asset: no sound tags; static-source: null backend
rows.capture_rule: Record null-audio capability in manifest; do not infer Flash audio state from Director PCM.
rows.restore_rule: Restore null-audio configuration only; a real Flash audio backend requires a separate codec and qualification.
rows.unsupported_reason: No Flash sound tags are present in this asset; the current null backend still provides no observed Flash audio continuation state.

rows.surface: NativeFlashHost instances, callback FIFO, sprite/generation/owner identity
rows.capture_rule: Capture logical sprite/cast/generation and Ruffle graph through the future internal hook; require the host FIFO already empty at the selected point, never drain it, and reject nonempty FIFO with structured unsupported.
rows.restore_rule: Allocate fresh Player/backend/callback buffers and rebind fresh owner/generation before host publication.
rows.unsupported_reason: Current NativeFlashSnapshot has only frame observation and cannot restore the live Player graph.

rows.surface: NativeAudioState prepared decoder/resampler sources, queues and PCM cursor
rows.capture_rule: Independent C1 subsystem; this B1 graph experiment does not capture or restore it.
rows.restore_rule: Requires a separate exact decoder/resampler suffix codec and active-PCM continuation oracle.
rows.unsupported_reason: Opaque Rodio Source state cannot be represented by a time cursor alone.

rows.surface: ObjectData native variants, properties/interfaces/watchers, AVM1 FunctionObject and Scope
rows.observed_actual: AVM1-qualified asset; live variants pending preflight
rows.capture_rule: Enumerate object/prototype/scope/function IDs and ordered property edges; immutable bytecode uses SWF slice identity; native builtins use pinned-build registry identity.
rows.restore_rule: Allocate script graph first, rebuild prototypes/scopes, then attach reconstructible registered host wrappers.
rows.unsupported_reason: Opaque native variant, unregistered host wrapper, watcher closure, or unknown object kind fails closed.

rows.surface: DisplayObjectBase transforms, filters, masks, bitmap/surface pixels, drawing state and cache inputs
rows.observed_actual: display asset inputs observed; live render history pending preflight
rows.capture_rule: Capture mutable pixels, dynamic drawing commands/state, masks, trails, filters, and cache-as-bitmap source inputs that affect future output/source observation; exclude only derived GPU/cache artifacts.
rows.restore_rule: Rebuild derived command/cache/GPU state from canonical persistent history before publish.
rows.unsupported_reason: Opaque backend resource or unclassified render history fails closed.

rows.capture_rule: Serialize nil/dead only when the source weak reference is actually nil/dead; serialize GraphId only when the live target is otherwise strongly retained; use process/GC addresses only as ephemeral alias-map keys.
rows.restore_rule: Allocate strong graph first, then rebuild weak handles; reject live weak-only targets and never promote targets to roots.
rows.unsupported_reason: Live weak target absent from the strong graph fails closed as weak_target_not_strongly_retained; address-derived serialized identity fails closed.
